chunks: Hamza ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn Al-Hussein ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) narrated in Qum in the month of Rajab of the year 339 A.H., saying: My father narrated to me from Yasir the servant, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him), from his father, from his forefathers, from Al-Hussein ibn Ali (peace be upon him), that the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali:

O Ali! You are the Proof of God, and you are the Gate of God, and you are the Path to God, and you are the Great Tidings, and you are the Straight Path, and you are the Supreme Example. O Ali! You are the Leader of the Muslims, and the Commander of the Faithful, and the Best of the Trustees, and the Master of the Truthful. O Ali! You are the Greatest Distinguisher [al-Faruq], and you are the Greatest Truthful. O Ali! You are my Caliph over my nation, and you are the one to pay my debts, and you are the fulfiller of my promises. O Ali! You are the oppressed one after me. O Ali! You are the one separated from me after me. O Ali! You are the forsaken one after me. I bear witness to God the Exalted and to whoever from my nation is present that your party is my party, and my party is the party of God, and the party of your enemies is the party of Satan.
ai.seo_question: What are the key titles and virtues attributed to Imam Ali in this hadith from al-Ridha?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this chain of transmission (*isnad*) traces back through the Imams to the Prophet, emphasizing the divine appointment (*Nass*) of Ali as the ultimate authority. The titles bestowed, such as 'Proof of God' (*Hujjat Allah*) and 'Gate of God' (*Bab Allah*), underscore his role as the intermediary between the Divine and the creation, a concept central to Shia theology. The concluding declaration of *Hizb Allah* (Party of God) links Ali’s political and spiritual leadership directly to the Quranic concept of the faithful party.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 30-13 In the (Arabic) month of Rajab of the year 339 A.H. (950 A.D.) in Qum Hamza ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn Al-Hussein ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (s) in narrated that his father quoted Yasir - the servant, on the authority of Abil Hassan Ali ibn Musa Al-Ridha (s), on the authority of his father (s), on the authority of his forefathers (s), on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Ali (s) that God’s Prophet (s) told Ali (s), “O Ali! You are the Proof of God. You are the Gate to God. You are the Road to God. You are the Great Tidings. You are the Straight Path. You are the Supreme Example. O Ali! You are the Leader of the Muslims. You are the Commander of the Faithful. You are the Best of the Trustees. You are the Master of the Companions. You are the greatest one who distinguishes truth from falsehood. You are the Greatest Companion. O Ali! You are my Caliph ruling over my nation. You are the one to pay back my debts. You are the one to fulfill my promises. O Ali! You are the oppressed one after me. O Ali! You are the one to be abandoned after me. O Ali! You are the one who will be forsaken after me. I hold the Sublime God and all who are present aswitnesses that your party is mine, and my party is that of God’s. Moreover, the party of your enemies is the party of Satan.”
